title: Business Application differs from its Service Instance
cardHint: A Business Application is a copy of its Service Instance: owners, status, description and name. SACM copies what differs.
cardText: A Business Application has the same Owned by, Managed by, Operational status and description as its Service Instance, and its name is the instance name without " - PROD" or " - TEST", plus "_BA" (procedure 2.9). With several instances: the production one whose name it carries. Nobody is asked about the owners, status, description or name of an application: SACM copies the value of the instance in ServiceNow. Use the fix list. When the instance itself is wrong, its own card asks its owner, in EPO.
